result.title: Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality
result.summary: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at https://github.com/fabienfrfr/Kairos . Python package at https://pypi.org/project/kairos-fm/ .

AI.brief_summary: Kairos 提出一个覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频、LiDAR 与控制流的字节级基础模型架构（LiZAttention2 线性注意力＋滑动窗口注意力、稀疏 MoE、多尺度字节编解码器），并在单句过拟合的小规模收敛性检查中比较各组件与注意力/编解码器选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨会话循环状态记忆门」与 gated DeltaNet 的递推状态更新、共享投影设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的维护与更新方式提供方法线索，但论文仅作收敛性 sanity check，明确未涉及推理、视觉证据使用或泛化，需人工核查其状态机制是否可迁移。
